Sasha: Heads-up — private on-prem node shows steady GPU memory growth when KV paging is enabled at threshold=0.6. Repro in perf_harness during long-context sweep (~30m).

Maria: Can you paste the perf run + nvml/pmap samples? also which driver, allocator, runtime build?

Sasha: quick paste below. model=redwood-13b, seq ramp 32->4096, kv_page_threshold=0.6
```
# nvml sample
GPU0 used=12.1GiB -> 17.8GiB after 30m
# /proc/pid/maps snippet
anon grows from ~12G -> 16G
# runtime log
[2026-03-16 12:14:02] kv_cache: page_evicted=342 page_compact_attempts=1
[2026-03-16 12:44:02] kv_cache: page_evicted=348 page_compact_attempts=1
```

Tim: a few leads: (1) page_size differs across clusters (onprem 128MB vs dedicated 64MB) -> worse fragmentation; (2) allocator differences: system allocator may not return pinned frames same as jemalloc shim; (3) a micro-op kernel change in newer runtime build may alter compact path activation.

Maria: @Tim please check allocator/uvm logs. Sasha, can you run with jemalloc shim + KR trace: `LD_PRELOAD=libjemalloc.so KR_LOG=alloc ./perf_harness --kv-page-threshold=0.6 --trace-alloc` for 10m and dump /proc/<pid>/maps afterwards?

Sasha: did that. Node diffs: private node driver=535.54 cuda=12.1 runtime=2026-02-10 allocator=system; dedicated box that was stable driver=535.65 runtime=2026-02-03 allocator=nvidia-jemalloc.

perf-bot: [regression-alert] KV cache memory growth detected on private-cluster-03. Baseline 12.1GiB -> 17.8GiB. linked run: https://perf.redwood/ops/2345 :warning:

Tim: runtime-build diff + allocator jump out. We merged a micro-op change in 2026-02-10 that flipped compact strategy to 'eager' but gated on allocator==nvidia-jemalloc. On system allocator the eager compact path isn't triggered -> free_ratio drifts down and fragmentation rises.

Maria: short-term mitigation: either enable jemalloc shim on customer node or make compact path allocator-agnostic. Which is lower risk?

Sasha: enabling jemalloc shim eliminated growth in a 20m run. Workaround confirmed.

Tim: good. Long-term: upstream deterministic compact path. Proposal: change kernel selection to include allocator type and always run a compact after eviction when free_ratio<0.15. Add a unit/integration test that simulates long-context churn to catch regressions. I'll draft an RFC.

Maria: add telemetry too: kv_fragmentation_ratio and kv_page_free_ratio per deployment in Console so ops can detect config drift. Also add check to Private rollout checklist.

perf-bot: [note] telemetry backlog item created: KV_FRAGMENTATION_RATIO / kv/page_free_ratio -> backlog #987 :white_check_mark:

Sasha: leaving jemalloc shim in customer cluster as a stopgap and will coordinate a QA canary next week with allocator-independent compact. I'll also drop commands for support.

Tim: please file an incident-avoidance doc in eng-runtime with repro commands, node config, and the shim workaround so support can respond quickly.

Maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
